description:
Use this when the user wants to pick a YouTube playlist for a post: "which playlists do I have". Returns
each playlist's playlist_id, title and video count (first 50) and whether RipClip may add videos to it.
Not for: putting the video in a playlist (update_draft) or channel numbers (get_account_stats). Free and read
only; it reads the channel from YouTube.

account_id.description: Id of the YouTube channel, from list_social_accounts. Empty works with one channel connected.

name: list_youtube_playlists
title: List YouTube playlists
